# Ashburn Computer Repair — Ashburn, VA

Ashburn Computer Repair is a service-area computer repair business serving
Ashburn, Virginia and nearby Northern Virginia communities, including
Sterling, Broadlands, Leesburg, Dulles, Lansdowne, and the rest of Loudoun
County. We do not operate a staffed office in Ashburn, VA.

## Contact

- Phone: (703) 997-2971
- Service area: Ashburn and Northern Virginia
- Website: https://www.ashburncomputerrepair.com/

## Services

- Laptop screen replacements
- Keyboard and hinge repairs
- Data recovery and backup
- Virus and malware removal
- Desktop and laptop repair
- Speed upgrades (SSD and RAM)
